headline: Best Ranch Pals in Palworld
title: Best Ranch Pals and What They Make | Honey, Milk, Eggs | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want free materials at your base? Build a Ranch in Palworld one point zero. It unlocks at technology level five and holds four Pals, and they need Farming work suitability. Beegarde makes Honey. Mozzarina makes Milk. Chikipi lays Eggs. Lamball, Cremis and Melpaca all give Wool. And Sibelyx makes High Quality Cloth, a big shortcut for crafting. Which Pal is working on your Ranch? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Ranch guide: unlocks at technology level 5, holds four Pals. Beegarde makes Honey, Mozzarina Milk, Chikipi Eggs, Lamball, Cremis and Melpaca Wool, Sibelyx High Quality Cloth.
